caption: The drawing features a composition set against a yellow irregularly-shaped background with jagged blue and red borders. In the upper left portion, there is a brown horse with a pink and red figure sitting astride it. The rider has a circular head and appears to be wearing clothing in shades of pink, with a darker brown patch for the hair or hat. Below and slightly to the right of the horse and rider, there is a light brown deer or elk with large antlers, depicted in a running or leaping pose. Three stylized flowers with thick brown stems and green leaves appear in the composition: one in the lower left corner with cream-colored petals, and two with pink petals situated on the right and upper parts of the image. The entire scene is framed by alternating bands of jagged blue and red edging beyond the yellow background.
title: Bedspread
